product.title: New Orleans Airboat Ride

description.text: Ride by airboat through cypress swamp and bayou waterways near Jean Lafitte National Historical Park and Preserve. This New Orleans-area tour focuses on marsh scenery, local wildlife, and captain-led interpretation, with optional hotel transportation on selected bookings and a direct meeting point in Lafitte. The route is water-based rather than a city sightseeing loop, so the experience centers on the airboat launch, swamp channels, and wildlife viewing conditions on the day of travel.

highlights: Airboat ride through cypress swamp and bayou waterways near Lafitte
Wildlife-focused route with seasonal chances to see alligators, birds, turtles, and other marsh animals
Captain-led commentary about the local wetlands and surrounding bayou country
Optional hotel pickup and drop-off available when the transportation option is selected

start.description: 5145 Fleming Park Rd, Lafitte, LA 70067, USA. Optional hotel pickup is available only when the transportation option is selected at booking.

end.description: This activity ends back at the meeting point.

itineraryItems.title: New Orleans pickup corridor
itineraryItems.description: Optional transportation begins from selected downtown New Orleans and French Quarter hotels before the ride to Lafitte.

itineraryItems.title: Lafitte airboat launch
itineraryItems.description: Guests meet at the Lafitte launch site, board the selected airboat size, and receive practical boarding instructions before entering the swamp.

itineraryItems.title: Jean Lafitte National Historical Park and Preserve area
itineraryItems.description: The airboat travels through nearby tidewater cypress swamp and bayou channels where wildlife sightings vary by season and conditions.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Lafitte
itineraryItems.description: The route returns to the launch area before guests depart independently or use the booked transportation option back toward New Orleans.

inclusions: Roundtrip transportation when the transportation option is selected at booking
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Not recommended for travelers with back problems
No heart problems or other serious medical conditions
Operates in rain unless conditions are unsafe
